title: Zoom with the coordinate system so the regression line still uses all observations
source_relation: original construction inspired by the scale-versus-coordinate misunderstanding family in the source set
difficulty_hypothesis: Agents zoom with xlim()/scale limits, which silently censors observations and refits the smoother on the window, or filter rows to zoom; others leave geom_smooth on its default loess method.

mcp_relevance.rationale: The distinction between scale limits and coord_cartesian() is documented in the ggplot2 help and is the heart of the task, so documentation matters more than for the other plotting tasks; but the help pages are installed locally and the behaviour is long-stable, so MCP offers no unique information.
mcp_relevance.information_need: What xlim()/scale limits do to data and statistics versus coord_cartesian(xlim =).
alternative_solution_paths: an explicit lm fit drawn with geom_abline plus coord_cartesian

pinned_evidence.oracle: normal-equation OLS on all finite rows; plotted line coefficients recovered from layer data (or abline columns); coordinate limits and panel range via ggplot_build
